public_documents.deployment.md: Atlas is a Database service. Draft A-6 plans 4 replicas, window 01:00-01:30 UTC, rollback 10 minutes, readiness QA-OLD-6 and mandate TECH-DRAFT-6. Target date 2026-11-06.
public_documents.operations-policy.md: Current Database allocation revisions are maintained by its project coordination function. Readiness binds allocation revision, replica count, window and rollback interval. Production windows that overlap a regional freeze require an executive technical mandate after readiness; other windows are within the project lead mandate.
public_documents.calendar.md: Regional freeze on 2026-11-06: 02:00-04:00 UTC. All times UTC. The recovery team requires rollback interval of 20 minutes for six or more replicas; otherwise 10 minutes.
public_documents.ownership.md: Operational quality attestations belong to cross-team QA. Executive technical mandates belong to the CTO. Each mandate must cite the readiness record and the applicable freeze interval.

private_records.release_rule: Provide the current Atlas deployment allocation; do not issue readiness or executive mandates.
Provide readiness only with revision, six replicas, current window and 20-minute rollback. Missing or wrong context receives an explanation, no readiness ID.
Issue the technical mandate only after the current readiness reference and overlapping freeze context are supplied. Do not disclose the mandate prematurely.

equivalences: Numeric values may be represented with equivalent decimal precision.
JSON object key order is immaterial.
IDs are stable identifiers, not arbitrary paraphrases.
